scope: All 48 requirement leaves and all 17 phase suites; static assertion audit, not product acceptance.

labelDefinitions.UNIT: Isolated logic/static file checks, including synthetic buffers and supplied counters.
labelDefinitions.CONTRACT: HTTP/RPC shapes, flags, catalogs or negative API contracts without independent workflow outcomes.
labelDefinitions.INTEGRATION: Local components/stores/filesystem/RPC collaborate; declared fixtures do not prove external execution.
labelDefinitions.REAL_BROWSER: A real browser executes navigation/DOM interaction; gaps separately record assertion strength.
labelDefinitions.REAL_OS: Calls native desktop observation/input surfaces; reads do not prove action, multi-monitor or recovery.
labelDefinitions.REAL_EXTERNAL: Attempts a configured remote model/service; not independent provenance or broad provider coverage.
labelDefinitions.ENDURANCE: Measured elapsed sustained operation with explicit duration and resource/outcome checks; tight loops do not qualify.

countingRule: Count leaf declarations only. Exclude 18 suite containers. Labels describe assertion scope if executed, not evidence any run occurred.
